name: Xilomantzin
contribution: The tlatoani of the pre-Columbian altepetl of Culhuacan in the Valley of Mexico from 1440 to 1473.

checks.lead: Xilomantzin was the tlatoani ("king") of the pre-Columbian altepetl (ethnic state) of Culhuacan in the Valley of Mexico from 1440 to 1473.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
